label: Pricing page
purpose: Present plans and convert a visitor into a paid plan.
when_to_use: A dedicated page whose job is to explain and sell plans.
when_not_to_use: A single price call-out inside another page — use the marketing/pricing section block instead.
composition: Plans — tier Cards + a billing-period toggle; the recommended plan carries a Badge + border-foreground
primary_action: Exactly one filled Button — the recommended plan's CTA. All other plan CTAs are outline.
responsive: Plan cards are a 3-col grid at md+ and stack below; the comparison Table scrolls horizontally in an overflow-x-auto container.
accessibility: included / not-included cells use an icon + sr-only text, never colour alone
each section is aria-labelledby its heading
the billing toggle is a Tabs (keyboard-navigable, roving focus)
content: Ships realistic 2one commercial copy (plan names, prices, feature rows) — adapt the CONTENT, keep the STRUCTURE.
anti_patterns: two competing primary buttons across the plan cards
hard-coding prices so the billing toggle is decorative
assumptions: Prices, plan names and feature rows are PLACEHOLDER 2one content — replace with the real offering.
The single primary action is the recommended (Team) plan's CTA; every other plan CTA is outline.
Annual billing shows an example −20% discount — wire it to real pricing.
Three tiers (Starter / Team / Enterprise); adjust the count to the real plans.

references.note: shadcn ships NO pricing/marketing/landing block — its canonical blocks are dashboard, sidebar, login and signup (https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks, checked 2026-08). So this pattern has no shadcn template to mirror and does not claim one. Its structure is composed from shadcn PRIMITIVES and existing 2one section blocks — every part traces to a real, in-repo source; nothing is invented.
